seoFaq.heading: China-to-Canada shipping: questions to ask before booking
seoFaq.intro: Check these details with the forwarder when comparing <1>shipping from China to Canada</1>. Prices and delivery estimates need to match your shipment and route.

time.title: What does the delivery estimate cover?
time.body: Ask whether the estimate starts at warehouse receipt, departure or another milestone. Confirm whether customs clearance and final delivery are included, and request the estimated departure date in writing.

cost.title: How should I compare shipping costs?
cost.body: Request an itemized quote for your packed cargo. Confirm the currency, chargeable weight or volume, included fees, exclusions, quote date and expiry date. Treat an unanswered fee as <1>not confirmed</1>.

us.title: Does this cover other shipping directions?
us.body: Canada-to-China and China-to-US shipments require different route-specific quotes. This comparison focuses on <1>shipments from China to Canada</1>.

seo.heading: Check your sea freight quote before booking
seo.intro: Check the chargeable weight or volume, included services, currency and expiry date so that you can compare the same shipment across providers. If a quote date or validity period is missing, ask the forwarder to confirm it; the page update date is not a quote verification date.

lcl.title: What should your sea freight quote include?
lcl.body: Ask for an itemized quote covering collection in China, origin handling, sea transport, destination handling, customs clearance services and final delivery where applicable. Ask whether duties, taxes, insurance and storage are included or excluded. An unanswered item should remain <1>not confirmed</1> in your comparison.

fcl.title: How is chargeable weight calculated?
fcl.body: Packed dimensions can affect the billed amount as well as actual weight. Ask the forwarder for its calculation method, minimum charge and rounding rule. Use that provider’s confirmed method when comparing your shipment; do not apply one carrier’s conversion factor to every listing.

vancouver.title: What does the transit estimate cover?
vancouver.body: Ask whether the estimate runs from warehouse receipt, vessel departure or another milestone, and whether customs clearance and final delivery are included. Request the estimated departure date and quote expiry date in writing before booking.
